Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 szDonorID varchar2(10);
 szProcedureCode varchar2(5);
 szDonationType varchar2(5);
 szCollDate date;
 szEligStatus varchar2(5);
 szDeferDate date;
 szDeferReason varchar2(50);
 szInterType varchar2(10);
 tmr timer;
 Idx number:=1;
 TmpFlg VARCHAR2(1);
 PermFlg VARCHAR2(1);
 TdefReason VARCHAR2(50);
 PdefReason VARCHAR2(50);
 donor_list VARCHAR2(200):= :Parameter.p_donor_list; 
 maxDeferDate DATE:=SYSDATE;
 v_local_time date; 
 cursor cur_procdesc is
 select initcap(description)
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code;

BEGIN

 If :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code is not null then

 open cur_procdesc;
 fetch cur_procdesc
 into :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc:=:valid_proc_codes.procedure_code||' - '||
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc;
 if cur_procdesc%NOTFOUND then
 :valid_proc_codes.proc_code_desc := 'Not available';
 end if;

 if cur_procdesc%ISOPEN then
 close cur_procdesc;
 end if;

 IF :parameter.p_donor_list is null then -- No duplicate donors

 szDonorID := :donors.donor_id;
 szProcedureCode := :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code;
 szDonationType := :donors.don_type;
 --szCollDate := sysdate;
 
 -- Added on 05/03/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 szCollDate := v_local_time;
 else
 szCollDate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
 
 don_core.check_eligibility(szDonorID,
 szProcedureCode,
 szDonationType,
 szCollDate,
 :donors.donor_weight, --- added for LT2018 (SCR: 151856)
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_date := szDeferDate;
 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_reason := szDeferReason;

 if szEligStatus = 'Y' then
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'Yes';
 :global.status:='Y'; ---(it is deferral flag: 'Y' means good donor)
 else
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'No';
 end if;


 if szInterType in ('PERMD','TEMPD','HOLDS') then
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','DEFERRAL_FLASH');
 else
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','GREEN_FLASH');
 end if;

 ELSE -- If duplicate donors then donor list is coming in

 szDonorID:=substr(donor_list,Idx,10);
 Loop
 --- message(szDonorID);pause;
 szProcedureCode := :valid_proc_codes.procedure_code;
 szDonationType := :donors.don_type;

 szEligStatus :=null;
 szDeferDate :=null;
 szInterType :=null;
 szDeferReason :=null;
 --szCollDate := sysdate; 
 -- Added on 05/03/2011; Timezone conversions code;
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);
 szCollDate := v_local_time;
 else
 szCollDate := sysdate;
 end if;
 end;
 ---------- 
 don_core.check_eligibility(szDonorID,
 szProcedureCode,
 szDonationType,
 szCollDate,
 :donors.donor_weight, --- added for LT2018 (SCR: 151856)
 szEligStatus,
 szDeferDate,
 szInterType,
 szDeferReason);

 if szEligStatus='N' and szDeferDate is not null then
 Tmpflg:='Y';
 if szDeferDate > maxDeferDate then
 maxDeferDate:= szDeferDate;
 TdefReason := szDeferReason;
 end if;
 end if;
 if szEligStatus='N' and szInterType='PERMD' then
 PermFlg:='Y';
 pdefReason := szDeferReason;
 end if;
 
 Idx:=Idx+10;
 szDonorID:=substr(donor_list,Idx,10);
 if szDonorId is null then
 exit;
 else
 null;
 end if;

 End Loop;

 if PermFlg is not null then 
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'No';
 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_reason := pDefReason;
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','DEFERRAL_FLASH');
 else
 if TmpFlg='Y' then 
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'No';
 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_date := maxDeferDate;
 :valid_proc_codes.deferral_reason := TdefReason;
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','DEFERRAL_FLASH');
 else
 :valid_proc_codes.elig_status := 'Yes';
 :global.status:='Y'; ---(it is deferral flag: 'Y' means good donor)
 display_item('VALID_PROC_CODES.ELIG_STATUS','GREEN_FLASH');
 end if;
 End if;
 END IF;
 

End if;

END;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chk_all number :=0;
BEGIN
 -- Added on 08/26/2014; IM 10092
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate);
 else
 :donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 /* set the donor id */

 :donor_interdictions1.donor_id := :donors.donor_id;
 
 
 /* Check whether the user has ALL access level */
 
 begin
 select 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='PROPR'
 and access_code_value='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1));
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all = 1 then
 set_block_property('donor_interdictions1',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where donor_id := :donors.donor_id
 and :donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate+1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''PROPR'')
 and DECODE(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID'); -- IM 10092/ IM:9509; chapter_id in donor_interdictions is 'ALL'; 
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 else

 /* set the default where . Inter type should not be DR ( property ) and the
 interdiction should be effective */

 set_block_property('donor_interdictions1',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'donor_id = :donors.donor_id
 and inter_code in(select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type=''PROPR''
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))
 and :donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,:donor_interdictions1.chp_sysdate+1)
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''PROPR'')
 and DECODE(chapter_id, ''ALL'', :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID, chapter_id) = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID'); -- IM 10092/ IM:9509; chapter_id in donor_interdictions is 'ALL'; 
 --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_ELIG_ATTRIB
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/*
** this procedure will do the actual work.
*/

PROCEDURE populate_elig_attrib IS
 szDonorID varchar2(10) := :parameter.p_donor_id;
 szChapter varchar2(5) := :parameter.p_chapter_id;
 nTotalDonations number;
 nCreditCount number;
 nDeferralCount number;
BEGIN

 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.DonChangeAllowed'); -- This global value is populated from health history program
 default_value(null,'GLOBAL.DonTypeToCheck');

 szDonorID := :parameter.p_DONOR_ID;
 :donors.donor_id := szDonorID;
 :donors.name := DON_STD.DONOR_NAME(szDonorID, szChapter);
 :donors.gender := DON_STD.DONOR_SEX (szDonorID, szChapter);
 :donors.date_of_birth := DON_STD.DONOR_DOB (szDonorID, szChapter);
 :donors.blood_type := substr(DON_STD.DONOR_ABO (szDonorID, szChapter), 1, 6);
 
 IF :donors.donor_weight IS NULL THEN
 :donors.donor_weight := DON_STD.DONOR_WEIGHT (szDonorID, szChapter); -- IM 693
 END IF; 
 
 If :GLOBAL.DonChangeAllowed ='N' then
 item_change('donors.don_type','D');
 item_change('donors.pb_don_list','D');
 Else
 item_change('donors.don_type','E');
 item_change('donors.pb_don_list','E');
 End if;

 If :GLOBAL.DonTypeToCheck is not null then 
 :donors.don_type:=LTrim(:GLOBAL.DonTypeToCheck);
 Else
 :donors.don_type:='AL';
 :donors.don_desc:='Allogenic';
 End if;

 -- IM 512
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 :ctrl_blk_1.chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF;
 -- IM 512

 go_block('valid_proc_codes');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 first_record;
 go_block('donor_interdictions1');
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 go_block('valid_proc_codes');
 first_record;

END;

PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2,pl_unit_def varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donors.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 

 
 call_form(p_window_name, NO_HIDE, NO_REPLACE, NO_QUERY_ONLY, pl_id);
END;
